headline: Siakam’s late three ends the Pacers’ skid
dek: Pascal Siakam hit the late three and Indiana snapped a four-game losing streak.
three: Pascal Siakam: 20 points and the late three
9 of 18 from the field with 8 rebounds and 5 assists.
Pacers up 5 at the half, then held on as OKC got within one or two five times late
Won it from three and with 30 assists
Threes made 15–13; assists 30–21. Indiana had 30 assists on its 49 baskets.
